Overview

Jundiaí is a city in SP with a population of 423,006. A prosperous city in São Paulo state, known for its high quality of life, Serra do Japi nature reserve, and strong industrial sector. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
